source: I can accept a delay if you explain the reason and the new timeline.
target: A delay is something I can accept… if you explain its reason and the new timeline.
references: A delay is something I can accept… if you explain its reason and the new timeline.
previous_target: A delay I can accept, provided you lay bare its reason and set forth the new timeline.

source: We need to make the process simpler for someone doing it for the first time.
target: We must make the process simpler for one who walks it for the first time.
references: We must make the process simpler for one who walks it for the first time.
previous_target: We must make the process simpler for one who walks this path for the first time.

source: I want us to learn from the failure instead of hiding it.
target: I would have us learn from the failure… rather than hide it away.
references: I would have us learn from the failure… rather than hide it away.
previous_target: I would have us learn from the failure, rather than bury it in shadow.

source: We cannot promise a date until the team confirms the estimate.
target: Until the team has confirmed the estimate, we cannot pledge a date.
references: Until the team has confirmed the estimate, we cannot pledge a date.
previous_target: No date can we pledge until the team has confirmed the estimate.

source: I need the freedom to question the plan without being labelled negative.
target: I require the freedom to question the plan without being branded negative.
references: I require the freedom to question the plan without being branded negative.
previous_target: I require the freedom to challenge the plan without being branded negative.

source: If the information is incomplete, we should say so clearly.
target: Should the information stand incomplete, we should declare it plainly.
references: Should the information stand incomplete, we should declare it plainly.
previous_target: If the information stands incomplete, we ought to proclaim it plainly.

source: I will stand by you, but I won't lie for you.
target: I will stand beside you… but I will not lie for you.
references: I will stand beside you… but I will not lie for you.
previous_target: I will stand beside you… but I will not speak falsehoods for you.

source: Let's separate what we know from what we are assuming.
target: Let us divide what we know from what we merely assume.
references: Let us divide what we know from what we merely assume.
previous_target: Let us draw a line between what we know and what we merely assume.

source: A good solution should still work when the original expert is unavailable.
target: A good solution should still work… even when the original expert is beyond reach.
references: A good solution should still work… even when the original expert is beyond reach.
previous_target: A good solution should endure even when its original expert is beyond reach.

source: I want a fair outcome, even if it is not the outcome I hoped for.
target: I seek a fair outcome, even if it is not the one I hoped for.
references: I seek a fair outcome, even if it is not the one I hoped for.
previous_target: I seek a fair outcome, even should it not be the one I hoped for.

source: Keep the original seal intact until the inspector arrives.
target: The original seal must remain unbroken… until the inspector arrives.
references: The original seal must remain unbroken… until the inspector arrives.
previous_target: Let the original seal remain unbroken until the inspector has arrived.

source: If Leo is late again, start the meeting without him.
target: Should Leo be late once more, begin the meeting without him… do not wait.
references: Should Leo be late once more, begin the meeting without him… do not wait.
previous_target: If Leo is late once more, do not wait for him. Begin the meeting.

source: I need the original file, not a screenshot.
target: I require the original file. A screenshot will not suffice.
references: I require the original file. A screenshot will not suffice.
previous_target: I require the original file. A screenshot shall not suffice.

source: We have saved 18,000 rupees, but the repair will cost 22,000.
target: We have saved eighteen thousand rupees… yet the repair shall demand twenty-two thousand.
references: We have saved eighteen thousand rupees… yet the repair shall demand twenty-two thousand.
previous_target: We have saved eighteen thousand rupees… yet the repair shall demand twenty-two thousand.

source: Do not give the spare medicine to anyone else.
target: Let the spare medicine pass to no one else.
references: Let the spare medicine pass to no one else.
previous_target: Let the spare medicine pass into no one else's hands.

source: Once the guests arrive, please serve the food.
target: Once the guests have arrived, serve the food, if you would.
references: Once the guests have arrived, serve the food, if you would.
previous_target: Once the guests have arrived, let the food be served, if you would.

source: I will call the mechanic if the engine makes that noise again.
target: Should the engine make that noise again… I shall call the mechanic.
references: Should the engine make that noise again… I shall call the mechanic.
previous_target: Should the engine utter that noise again, I shall summon the mechanic.

source: The blue folder belongs to Sana, while the green one is mine.
target: The blue folder is Sana's, while the green one belongs to me.
references: The blue folder is Sana's, while the green one belongs to me.
previous_target: The blue folder is Sana's to claim, while the green one belongs to me.

source: I can take the 2:20 train, but not the 2:05 one.
target: I can take the two twenty train… but not the two oh five.
references: I can take the two twenty train… but not the two oh five.
previous_target: I can board the two twenty train, but the two oh five is beyond me.

source: Please ask Farah before using her laptop.
target: Before you use Farah's laptop, ask her, if you would.
references: Before you use Farah's laptop, ask her, if you would.
previous_target: Before you use Farah's laptop, seek her permission, if you would.

source: The water filter needs a new cartridge every six months.
target: Every six months, the water filter demands a new cartridge.
references: Every six months, the water filter demands a new cartridge.
previous_target: Every six months, the water filter demands a new cartridge.

source: I did not receive the parcel that was marked delivered yesterday.
target: The parcel was marked delivered yesterday… yet it never reached my hands.
references: The parcel was marked delivered yesterday… yet it never reached my hands.
previous_target: The parcel was marked delivered yesterday, yet it never reached my hands.

source: Unless both parents agree, the school trip form cannot be submitted.
target: Unless both parents agree… the school trip form cannot be submitted.
references: Unless both parents agree… the school trip form cannot be submitted.
previous_target: Without the consent of both parents, the school trip form cannot be submitted.

source: The technician will arrive between 11 am and noon.
target: The technician shall arrive between eleven in the morning and noon.
references: The technician shall arrive between eleven in the morning and noon.
previous_target: The technician shall arrive between eleven in the morning and the stroke of noon.

source: I would rather wait one day than send the wrong document.
target: I would rather endure one day of waiting… than send the wrong document.
references: I would rather endure one day of waiting… than send the wrong document.
previous_target: I would rather endure a single day of waiting than send the wrong document.
